verdict.rationale: Latham states an early-stage financing practice covering angel and seed investments. It advises on hundreds of emerging-company financings a year, offers a convertible-note document generator (the Automated Convertible Note), and lists 'SAFE Investment' in its Book of Jargon glossary. SAFE-specific depth is thin: the only SAFE evidence is a glossary entry, with no SAFE form, explainer, or described SAFE/pre-seed practice. Missing for 10: published SAFE forms or templates, in-depth SAFE or convertible explainers, explicit pre-seed SAFE deal experience, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice

citations.quote: from angel and seed investments to structured debt and equity solutions
develop the Automated Convertible Note, an OpenLaw-based document generator that helps startups raise capital with customizable market standard terms
we advise on hundreds of emerging company financings totaling billions of dollars every year.
